name: Quote
description: The broker's working quotation for an Antipodean product. Distributor-side (the brokerage's own account). Sole writer: the broker's own authenticated session -- nothing automated ever patches this record. Wave 2 added the form: one form (id 'default'), 14 cards, 8 of them gated on selected_products. schema.required is deliberately EMPTY -- requiredness is a `required` rule per question, because validation runs against the merged record and a partial save would otherwise be checked against the whole schema. The AHCL01-05 questions carry NO required rule: open question A-00 (do the five render together or are they alternatives?) decides that and is unanswered. gen_occupation has no props.options (A-06) and renders an empty picker until the rate table exists.

submitted_snapshot.title: Submitted snapshot
submitted_snapshot.description: DISTRIBUTOR-side, for P18's local diff (§1.7). NOT the publisher-side baseline snapshot that submissions made redundant (§6.1) -- two different fields in two different accounts. Written ONLY by the broker's own session, in the same save that submits (see D-submitted_snapshot in the report). Not indexed (arbitrary nested answer shape -- a snapshot of quote_config's own answer keys, so no fixed leaf set is declared here). additionalProperties deliberately omitted: records-service's JSONSchema model rejects a literal bool there (json: cannot unmarshal bool into ... additionalProperties of type model.JSONSchema) -- confirmed live on staging.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files the broker attaches (e.g. claims history, prior policy schedules). D1 reads and forwards these through the gateway at submit; D1 does not write this key.  Modelled as an array of object-store references pending that input type. CORRECTED at G1: an `uploader` input type DOES exist (microstrate records.utils.ts inputOptionsForType, added 2026-08-10; quiva-records-mcp's catalogue was stale and has been updated). It is not used here because it binds an array of STRINGS and stores file paths only, which would drop file_name and content_type. Wave 2 must choose: keep this object shape and author a custom control, or flatten to string[] object keys and read the metadata back from the object store.

flow.title: New business quote
flow.intro: We will take this a page at a time. Each page saves on its own, so you can stop and come back. Only the product sections you select are asked.

sections.title: Cover selection
sections.say: Which Antipodean products is this quote for? Your selection decides which question sets follow.

sections.title: About the business
sections.say: Now the business itself — occupation, size and where its revenue comes from. The state splits must add up to 100.

sections.title: Claims and history
sections.say: Insurance, claims and conduct history for the last five years.

sections.title: Information Technology Combined Liability (ITL)
sections.say: The ITL question set — delivery controls, the sectors you work in, and your use of AI.

sections.title: General Property (GPI)
sections.say: General Property — the limit and excess you want, and the items you want specified.

sections.title: Cyber & Privacy Liability (CPL)
sections.say: Cyber and Privacy Liability — limits and excess.

sections.title: Attachments and submission
sections.say: Anything to attach, any notes for the underwriter, and then submit.
